review_description: Brite Spark were the most prompt in sending a quote out of the four companies that I spoke to (2 sent no quote at all). Thanks to the information supplied by solar quotes i was able to understand the difference in the cost of quotes to the quality of the products quoted and was happy with price and quality of the Brite Spark quote. The installation date was booked in with in a day of accepting the quote for the following week  and the installation  went with out a hitch with good follow up.
